description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, staff development, and regulatory adherence. This is an urgent opening for a leader passionate about making a significant impact on residents' lives and fostering a supportive environment for healthcare professionals. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Demonstrated experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.

description: Are you an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for leadership and quality patient care? A premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS, is seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join their compassionate team. This is an exceptional opportunity to advance your career and make a significant impact on resident well-being.In this vital leadership role, you will support the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of care are met. You will play a key role in staff supervision, training, and development, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. We are looking for a proactive leader who is committed to excellence and continuous improvement.This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and dedication. If you are an RN ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding leadership position, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Commitment to providing high-quality patient care

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. In this full-time role, you will be instrumental in ensuring accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, care plans, and related documentation. Your expertise will contribute significantly to resident care planning, regulatory compliance, and reimbursement processes.This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $36-$40, reflecting your valuable skills and commitment. We are looking for a professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents. If you are an RN with a strong background in MDS, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and federal/state regulations
Strong assessment, documentation, and organizational skills
Ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams
